notes.title: Ver 0.7.3 Update
notes.content:
Ver 0.7.3 update has been released.
This update slightly changes the block erase effects, and changes the gameplay somewhat.
We welcome feedback on the gameplay and presentation aspects of the effects.

The following fixes are included in this version.

[list]
[*]Changes to the block erase effects.
[*]Changed the standing picture used in the victory screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Ver 0.7.2 Update
notes.content:
Ver 0.7.2 update has been distributed.
The following fixes are included.

[list]
[*]Stabilization of some processes.
[*]Adjustment of the priority of standing pictures in the story mode.
[*]Added explanation of the stock system to the manual.
[*]Removed noise from some sound effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Ver 0.7.1 Update
notes.content:
Ver 0.7.1 update has been distributed.
The following fixes are included.

[list]
[*]Changed so that the pause button is disabled where it was sometimes enabled when the game was over during a battle.
[/list]

notes.title: "Egg War Puzzle" Available now!
notes.content:
Egg War Puzzle, a mixed-mode fighting falling-puzzle action game, is now available for early access!
In the Early Access version, you can enjoy the following elements

[list]
[*]More than 50 skills and powers of all 15 characters
[*]Two distinctly different control styles for a mix of different types of battles.
[*]Complete freedom to combine characters, tag teams, and styles!
[*]Story missions about the island
[*]Partial multiplayer support (also supports Remote Play Together).
[/list]

Future updates will include
[list]
[*]Additional story scenarios for the rest of the game.
[*]Addition of a character creation mode
[*]Balance adjustments based on feedback
[/list]
